    • poll

      public @Nullable T poll()
      Description copied from interface: BodyElements
      Take the next element if it is available at once, without waiting: an element that the elements already received, e.g. the next one of a piece of the body that completed several elements. Never starts reading the body and never blocks; BodyElements.next() reads it.

      The default implementation returns null: only BodyElements.next() reads the elements.

      Specified by:
      poll in interface BodyElements<S>
      Returns:
      The element, or null if no element is available at once: none was received yet, at the end of the body, after a failure, see BodyElements.state()

    • state

      public BodyElements.State state()
      Description copied from interface: BodyElements
      The state of the elements: whether BodyElements.poll() returns an element, BodyElements.next() has to wait for one, or the elements ended. Not an operation: it can be called at any time.

      The default implementation returns BodyElements.State.PENDING: whether an element is available is only known by reading it.

      Specified by:
      state in interface BodyElements<S>
      Returns:
      The state

    • forEach

      public CompletionStage<Void> forEach(Function<? super T, ? extends CompletionStage<?>> consumer)
      Description copied from interface: BodyElements
      Consume the remaining elements in order. The next element is read when the stage returned for the previous one completes. Elements that are available at once (BodyElements.poll()) are consumed in a loop, so many of them do not deepen the stack. When reading the body or a consumer fails, the elements are closed.
      Specified by:
      forEach in interface BodyElements<S>
      Parameters:
      consumer - Consumes an element, completing when it is done with it
      Returns:
      Completes when every remaining element was consumed, or exceptionally when reading the body or a consumer fails

    • closeAsync

      public CompletionStage<Void> closeAsync()
      Description copied from interface: BodyElements
      Close the elements, e.g. discard the rest of the body. An operation that has not completed ends with a CancellationException. For the instances of the framework, closing again returns the same stage.
      Specified by:
      closeAsync in interface BodyElements<S>
      Returns:
      Completes when the elements were closed, or exceptionally if closing failed

    • close

      public void close()
      Description copied from interface: BodyElements
      Close like BodyElements.closeAsync(), without waiting for it. Does nothing by default: elements that hold resources, e.g. a database cursor, release them here.
